text:
Connor O'Brien: ok folks, need release coord for auto-rollback-on-SLO. trying to lock flag names + staged cohorts + who signs off before we flip beyond internal.

Talia Benson: +1. also need the comms template + rollback plan for the feature itself (kill switch) before Thurs.

Ethan Park: control plane side is ready behind flags. we have a few names floating around though.

Benji Okafor: can we settle on one primary gating flag for the evaluator/executor path? currently in code i have `rollout_controller.auto_rollback.enabled`.

Sean Gallagher: SRE request: separate flag for “can *take action*” vs “only compute verdict”. we want to run it in shadow mode first.

Paula Mendes: +1, product wants to show verdict in Console even if action disabled (helps tune policy defaults + trust).

Chloe Martin: console backend can hide UI behind `console.rollouts.auto_rollback` but we can also show “beta” badge for internal only.

Connor O'Brien: proposal (please react/approve):
1) `rollout_controller.auto_rollback.verdict_enabled` (compute + persist verdict)
2) `rollout_controller.auto_rollback.executor_enabled` (actually revert traffic split)
3) `console.rollouts.auto_rollback_ui_enabled` (verdict + history screens)
4) `incident_bot.auto_rollback_notifications_enabled` (Slack paging formatting)

Connor O'Brien: naming notes: prefix matches service, avoids generic `auto_rollback` collisions. ok?

Ethan Park: :thumbsup: from me

Benji Okafor: :thumbsup: works. executor flag will be checked at last mile before we call routing service.

Sean Gallagher: :thumbsup: but pls ensure executor flag is per-env and we can override per-tenant (at least via config) if something goes sideways.

Rafael Mendes: +1 and we need a documented “pause” flow in runbook. (also, do we page on every rollback or only if >N in 30m?)

Paula Mendes: paging policy in SRE doc draft is “page if rollback executed on enterprise/dedicated tier OR if >3 rollbacks in 15m global”.

Miles Thornton: game day found the global burst case. please add rate limit: max 1 rollback per tenant per 30m, and global cap per region per 10m. (i think Benji added?)

Benji Okafor: yep. idempotency key is `tenant_id + route_id + active_version + policy_hash`.

Connor O'Brien: cool. staged rollout cohorts — here’s what I’m putting in the launch checklist unless objections:
- Cohort 0: internal “dogfood” routes (redwood-console + docs infra) in us-west-2 only, verdict_enabled=true, executor_enabled=false (shadow)
- Cohort 1: internal canary tenants (hand-picked), verdict_enabled=true, executor_enabled=true, min_traffic guardrails on
- Cohort 2: Hosted API low-risk tenants (free/dev tier) in 1 region, business hours only
- Cohort 3: Hosted API broader (all non-enterprise), multi-region
- Cohort 4: Dedicated pilots (only accounts explicitly opted-in)
- Cohort 5: Enterprise/Dedicated default-on (GA)

Marissa Cole: product ask: before Cohort 2 we need Console showing verdict + “why” (monitor links) + rollback history. otherwise support gets blind-sided.

Chloe Martin: console screens are ready in staging. we can gate UI to only show for tenants where verdict_enabled is on (to avoid “empty state confusion”).

Sean Gallagher: also need the monitor identity migration % before we go past Cohort 1. if labels are inconsistent we’ll get unknown verdicts and people will think it’s broken.

Ethan Park: we have explicit unknown verdict handling now (fails open by default for executor, i.e., do NOT rollback on unknown). this was per arch review.

Rafael Mendes: can we confirm what “fail open” means in practice? for oncall: if monitoring down, we *don’t* rollback, and we page? ticket?

Sean Gallagher: my vote: no auto rollback + create ticket, page only if this affects enterprise tier during active rollout. otherwise too noisy.

Connor O'Brien: ok. sign-offs needed before Cohort 1 -> 2:
- Platform/control plane (Ethan or Benji)
- SRE (Sean or Rafael)
- Product (Marissa or Paula)
- Console (Chloe) confirming UI + links
- Compliance/audit (Naomi) for audit events format + retention

Naomi Feldman: for compliance: I need confirmation audit events include actor=system, policy version/hash, old/new traffic split, and a stable “reason” code (latency_slo_breach / error_slo_breach / baseline_regression / manual_override). also need the event to be exportable like other rollout events.

Benji Okafor: audit payload includes policy_hash + reason enum + monitor IDs. actor is `system:auto_rollback`. (Marcus signed off on schema in PR review, but Naomi please take a look at sample event?)

Naomi Feldman: yep, send sample and I’ll confirm.

Connor O'Brien: Deploy window: can we do Cohort 1 enablement Tues 10am PT? (so SRE + platform around). and Cohort 2 not before Thurs after game day follow-ups.

Miles Thornton: +1. also recommend we keep Cohort 1 running 48h before expanding.

Paula Mendes: agreed. also want to confirm defaults: warm-up window 10m after rollout start where verdict is computed but executor suppressed.

Sean Gallagher: 10m is fine for hosted. for dedicated slow warm-ups might be 15m. can we make warm_up per-tier? (or just set dedicated policy default higher)

Ethan Park: policy supports per-tier overrides. we can ship default dedicated warm_up=15m, min_requests=300.

Connor O'Brien: action items:
- Connor: update launch checklist w/ final flags + cohorts + sign-offs
- Benji/Ethan: post sample audit event + confirm reason codes
- Chloe/Marissa: confirm Console rollout page links to runbook + monitor dashboards
- Sean/Rafael: confirm paging/ticketing rules for rollback executed vs unknown verdict

DeployBot: staging deploy scheduled by Connor O'Brien for service `rollout-controller` (build redwood@a1f3c9d). Flags unchanged.

Rafael Mendes: :thumbsup: I’ll update runbook w/ “unknown verdict” path and pause instructions.

Marissa Cole: I’ll ping Kenji to double-check the UI wording (avoid “we rolled back” when only verdict is red).

Connor O'Brien: perfect. pls reply here once each sign-off is done so we can attach to the release ticket.
